what: Rows a non-owner reader is served by resolveLens / resolve_lens: in every link field only the ids that reader can see, as keel serves bodies (elements/visibility.py redact, elements/serialize.py x_served_trimmed). Each case: a world (elements as the owner is served them, hidden: true on the hidden, now), a lens id, a reader, and the rows it must get, in order. The npm and Python packages hold the same bytes.

cases.note: The planted case: a room linking a hidden Object, a Relation naming a hidden Character, a Domain naming a hidden hub. The public row drops each id it cannot see (a missing id too) and carries no x_served_trimmed.
